items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: I didn’t choose it because of Charlie Christian or Barney Kessel or Wes Montgomery

ctx.x: What about the rock & roll of the day, the Ventures and all that kind of thing?

That was influential for sure, yeah. I mean I think because I had chosen the guitar as an instrument, and I didn’t choose it because of Charlie Christian or Barney Kessel or Wes Montgomery, I chose it because of people like you’re mentioning, you know like Chuck Berry, the Ventures, Bo Diddley, Elvis Presley and all these kind of people. So I chose it as a way to like maybe gain social acceptance you know. And plus I liked the sound of the electric guitar. And my first guitar was acoustic. It was a Harmony…
Oh, this is a true story.
